entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand GPS tracker.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number please?
Jane Doe, order number is VF88602. Look, I just need a yes or no. Can I return it?
I understand you're looking for a direct answer. Just to make sure I'm sending you down the right path, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken. It's just... confusing. I find the whole interface hard to use, and honestly, I expected more from it. I even read the user manual front to back and it didn't help. So, can I return it or not?
I see. Thank you for clarifying that, Jane. One moment while I pull up your order details and our policy.
Alright, I'm looking at your order now. It was delivered 12 days ago. According to our policy, items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So yes, you are well within the timeframe.
Great. Finally. So what's the next step?

I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
I see the email. Okay, thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
